questionnaire.question: Do the helmets and safety shoes you offer carry the ISI mark (IS 2925 and IS 15298)? Share BIS licence numbers.
Attach the EN 388 test report for the cut-resistant glove model you are quoting.
Do you hold a valid ISO 9001 certificate? Attach a copy.
Lead time from purchase order to delivery, in days.
Minimum order quantity per line, if any.
Payment terms offered (Kaveri standard is 60 days from delivery).
Can you deliver to all three plants (Pune, Sonipat, Hosur)?
Replacement policy for defective or non-conforming goods.
Minimum remaining shelf life of disposables (masks, gloves) at delivery.
Can you provide samples before the order? Lead time for samples.

qualification_rule: Qualified if: ISI licences evidenced for helmets and shoes (Q1), valid ISO 9001 on the award date (Q3), and lead time of 21 days or less for every quoted line (Q4).
terms: Quote in INR, per the unit stated for each line, excluding GST. Show GST rate separately.
Prices to be delivered (landed) to each of the three plants. State the freight basis if not included.
State pack size wherever you quote per box, packet or carton.
Quote every line. If you cannot supply a line, write 'Not quoted'. Do not offer substitutes without marking them.
Payment terms: 60 days from delivery (Kaveri standard). State any deviation.
Quotation validity: at least 90 days from the due date.
Contract period: 1 October 2026 to 30 September 2027, with call-off orders per plant.
